text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install an all-way stop control at the intersection of Dan Leckie Way and Housey Street. The installation is recommended based on pedestrian crossing activity in the vicinity and spacing to adjacent pedestrian crossing protection. An all-way stop control will enhance safety for pedestrians, cyclists and motorists using this intersection.
The Toronto and East York Community Council 1. Authorized an all-way stop control at the intersection of Dan Leckie Way and Housey Street.
